picks.title: How Fortell is using AI (and $163M) to crack a hearing aid monopoly
picks.why_it_matters: A $163M raise backed by Thrive and Founders Fund signals major VC conviction that AI-enabled medical devices can disrupt entrenched healthcare incumbents—a thesis early-stage investors can apply to adjacent regulated markets.

picks.title: Comp AI sets eyes on a continuously agentic future for security and compliance
picks.why_it_matters: A $34M Series A for agentic security/compliance automation validates growing enterprise appetite for AI that handles tedious regulatory work—a category where early-stage startups can still compete on vertical specialization.

picks.title: Pulley, a Carta rival, is shutting down
picks.why_it_matters: Despite backing from GC, Stripe, and Founders Fund, Pulley's shutdown reveals how brutal it is to unseat entrenched fintech infrastructure—a cautionary signal for founders pitching 'better Carta' plays and a reminder that strong cap tables don't guarantee survival.
